items.title: Wells Fargo, Cisco, Marvell among latest firms objecting to OKXICE's tokenized stock plan
items.snippet: Six more companies have objected to listing tokenized versions of their stock on the venue, Reuters reported, bringing the total to 22.

items.title: Bitcoin’s wealthy holders turning to loans and yield as investment habits mature: Xapo CEO
items.snippet: Borrowing against bitcoin and earning income to build their BTC holdings are becoming priorities for long-term investors, Xapo Bank CEO Seamus Rocca told CoinDesk.

items.title: Hong Kong’s Biggest Bank Puts a Stablecoin in 3 Million Wallets
items.snippet: HSBC switched on its Hong Kong dollar stablecoin inside PayMe on Friday, testing whether a bank-issued token can become everyday money.

items.title: U.S. Clarity Act failure gives Asia and Middle East a competitive edge, says Apex Group CEO
items.snippet: Apex Group CEO Peter Hughes warned that the failure of the U.S. Clarity Act will drive digital asset businesses toward faster-moving jurisdictions in Asia and the Middle East.

items.title: Franklin Templeton adds $150 million in fund shares to XRP Ledger, all in one wallet
items.snippet: Two subscriptions on Thursday nearly quadrupled the fund’s tokens on the network. The receiving wallet shares its authorized signers with the issuer.
